/publication/composition/does-ozempic-ca.description: GLP-1 weight loss can include lean tissue. Lean mass is not muscle. SURMOUNT 1 found about 25% of lost weight was lean mass. Education only.
/publication/composition/does-ozempic-ca.imageAlt: Adult pausing during a strength session at home

jsonLd.headline: Does Ozempic cause muscle loss? What the trials actually measured
jsonLd.description: GLP-1 weight loss can include lean tissue. Lean mass is not muscle. SURMOUNT 1 found about 25% of lost weight was lean mass. Education only.
jsonLd.abstract: GLP-1 assisted weight loss can include lean tissue, but lean mass is not the same as muscle, fat generally falls more, and function must be measured rather than inferred from a scan.
citation: Wilding et al., STEP 1, New England Journal of Medicine, 2021, dossier [1]
King et al., STEP 1 DEXA substudy, 2021, dossier [11]
Look et al., SURMOUNT-1 DEXA substudy, Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism, 2025, dossier [12]
Karakasis et al., network meta-analysis of 22 trials, 2025, dossier [13]
Langer et al., Cell Metabolism, 2026, dossier [16]
Bellicha et al., Obesity Reviews, 2021, dossier [21]

acceptedAnswer.text: GLP-1 assisted weight loss can include lean tissue, but lean mass is not the same as muscle, fat generally falls more, and function must be measured rather than inferred from a scan.

mainEntity.name: What can this evidence not tell us?

acceptedAnswer.text: These substudies cannot say how much of any individual lean mass change was skeletal muscle. Study averages describe groups under trial conditions, not what one person should expect. No supplement has been shown in a large randomized trial to prevent muscle loss specifically during semaglutide or tirzepatide treatment.

No. Peptis Publication essays are education from original trials and official labels. They are not medical advice and do not describe Peptis product results. Talk with your current clinician before changing medication, diet, supplements or exercise.

jsonLd.headline: Lean mass vs muscle mass: why DEXA headlines can mislead
jsonLd.description: DEXA lean mass includes water, organs, connective tissue and bone mineral, not just skeletal muscle. Track function with the scan. Education only.
jsonLd.abstract: A DEXA lean mass estimate includes water, organs, connective tissue and bone mineral alongside skeletal muscle. Trend consistency and functional measures tell you more than any single scan.
citation: Tinsley and Heymsfield, Journal of the Endocrine Society, 2024, dossier [15]
Look et al., SURMOUNT-1 DEXA substudy, 2025, dossier [12]
Langer et al., Cell Metabolism, 2026, dossier [16]

mainEntity.name: What should a reader know about muscle and body composition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A DEXA lean mass estimate includes water, organs, connective tissue and bone mineral alongside skeletal muscle. Trend consistency and functional measures tell you more than any single scan.

mainEntity.name: What can this evidence not tell us?

acceptedAnswer.text: No consumer scan can validate a muscle-preservation claim with the rigor of a designed clinical study. A single reading cannot distinguish water shifts from tissue change.

No. Peptis Publication essays are education from original trials and official labels. They are not medical advice and do not describe Peptis product results. Talk with your current clinician before changing medication, diet, supplements or exercise.

jsonLd.abstract: Reviews support roughly 1.2 to 1.6 g/kg/day and 25 to 30 g per meal for many active weight loss contexts, but the weight denominator and your medical situation require individual guidance.

mainEntity.name: How much protein do you need on a GLP-1?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reviews support roughly 1.2 to 1.6 g/kg/day and 25 to 30 g per meal for many active weight loss contexts, but the weight denominator and your medical situation require individual guidance.

mainEntity.name: What can this evidence not tell us?

acceptedAnswer.text: These ranges come from general active weight loss research, not GLP-1 specific dosing trials. No review can set your personal target; medical conditions change the answer.

jsonLd.headline: A two-day strength plan for beginners during weight loss
jsonLd.description: Resistance training has the strongest evidence for retaining lean tissue in general weight loss. Two full-body sessions are a start. Education only.
jsonLd.abstract: Two progressive full-body sessions each week are a credible minimum for beginners. Train the major movement patterns, leave repetitions in reserve, and progress only when technique is stable.
citation: Bellicha et al., Obesity Reviews, 2021, dossier [21]
Villareal et al., New England Journal of Medicine, 2017, dossier [22]
Armamento-Villareal et al., JBMR, 2020, dossier [23]

mainEntity.name: What should a reader know about training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Two progressive full-body sessions each week are a credible minimum for beginners. Train the major movement patterns, leave repetitions in reserve, and progress only when technique is stable.

mainEntity.name: What can this evidence not tell us?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal training dose during modern incretin therapy is inferred mainly from general weight loss and sports science evidence. A written plan cannot screen your individual injury or medical situation.

jsonLd.headline: What happens after stopping semaglutide? The STEP 1 extension explained
jsonLd.description: STEP 1 extension participants regained about two thirds of prior weight loss a year after stopping. That is chronic biology, not failure. Education only.
jsonLd.abstract: One year after semaglutide and lifestyle support ended, STEP 1 extension participants regained about two thirds of their prior weight loss. Maintenance habits deserve to begin before discontinuation, not after regain.
citation: Wilding et al., STEP 1 extension, Diabetes, Obesity and Metabolism, 2022, dossier [9]
Rubino et al., STEP 4, JAMA, 2021, dossier [10]

acceptedAnswer.text: One year after semaglutide and lifestyle support ended, STEP 1 extension participants regained about two thirds of their prior weight loss. Maintenance habits deserve to begin before discontinuation, not after regain.

mainEntity.name: What can this evidence not tell us?

acceptedAnswer.text: Withdrawal trials compare stopping with continuing; they do not test tapering strategies or individual plans. Group regain averages do not predict any single person’s outcome.

jsonLd.description: High-quality collagen trials do not show a clear skin benefit. No supplement is shown to prevent loose skin during GLP-1 weight loss. Education only.
jsonLd.abstract: A 2025 analysis found no clear skin benefit from oral collagen in high-quality or non-industry-funded studies, and no supplement has been shown to prevent loose skin during GLP-1 assisted weight loss.
citation: Myung and Park, American Journal of Medicine, 2025, dossier [32]

Sami et al., Aesthetic Plastic Surgery, 2015, dossier [34]
Ashtary-Larky et al., British Journal of Nutrition, 2020, dossier [46]

mainEntity.name: Does collagen prevent loose skin after weight loss?

acceptedAnswer.text: A 2025 analysis found no clear skin benefit from oral collagen in high-quality or non-industry-funded studies, and no supplement has been shown to prevent loose skin during GLP-1 assisted weight loss.

mainEntity.name: What can this evidence not tell us?

acceptedAnswer.text: Skin aging trials do not directly study excess skin after major weight loss. No randomized trial has tested collagen for loose-skin prevention during GLP-1 treatment.
